DENT 407.course_name: Special Oral Care in the Community
DENT 407.description: Provision of special oral health services in community settings. Prerequisite: All of DHYG 405, DHYG 435. Prerequisites may be waived for non-program dental hygienists and others.

DENT 410.course_name: Dentistry I: Foundations of Clinical Dentistry
DENT 410.description: Fundamentals of human biology, body systems, diseases, and supporting basic oral health sciences. Learning in small groups, classroom, laboratory, and clinical settings utilizing technology. Professionalism, ethics, interprofessional education and the social contract, communication skills, and critical evaluation of the literature. Begin to apply foundation knowledge and skills to patient assessment and care. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

DENT 420.description: Continued exposure to body systems and the supporting biomedical sciences with applications in dental clinical sciences, integrated into small group learning, classroom, laboratory, and community settings utilizing technology; continued engagement in professionalism, ethics and communication skills. Prerequisite: DENT_V 410. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

DENT 430.description: A multi-disciplinary course integrating didactic, simulation, clinical, and community service learning. Students function as team members in clinical group practices with individual progression through the Clinical Clerkships. Prerequisite: DENT420

DENT 440.description: A continuing integrated, multi-disciplinary course with ongoing participation in clinical group practices and individual progression through the Clinical Clerkships and community service learning. Prerequisite: DENT_V 430. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
